rationale: Multiple transaction functions (LinkContractCreate, LinkContractBiding, LinkContractDeal, LinkContractClose) use time.Now() to set bill.VersionTime, which is then written to the ledger via putBill()/PutState(). Since time.Now() returns different values on different endorsing peers, this causes endorsement divergence.
